summary: Mrs. Cary is flustered about not having her book ready; a bystander reassures her and she sings a line.

blocks.x: If I had known that I'd have had this book, Hems, picked out. I didn't know.
Well, listen, you would know no harm to, see things like that, you get excited and you can't do anything.
I get excited. We will walk through the valley, we will walk in pieces, we will walk through the valley with tears of the Lord.
